comparison_policy: Every raw binary32 word including NaN sign, signaling/quiet bit and payload; absolute Version and opaque Tensor/Storage identity relations. Never normalize NaNs.
scalar_admission_policy: Observe requested f32 word, Python f64 Scalar word and admitted f32 word. Native comparison must use admitted f32 bits for the Python Scalar contract.
identity_policy: Equal Version counters do not establish shared Version identity.
not_covered: native equality is not established by this observation-only probe

release_source_equivalence.change: The release commit adds five lines under [tool.ruff], setting target-version to py310 with explanatory comments. There are no deletions. Every other root entry and every source subtree is identical.
release_source_equivalence.scope: Only this exact official wheel SHA256/build commit and this exact inventory release commit. This is source equivalence for the recorded lint-only release change, not identity of the two Git commits or an allowance for other builds.
